Name: Tortilla Espanola
Steps: Peel and slice the potatoes into thin rounds.
Cook potatoes and onion slowly in olive oil until soft, not crispy.
Beat eggs with salt in a large bowl.
Drain the potatoes and onion, then fold them into the egg mixture.
Cook in a non-stick pan over medium heat until set on one side.
Flip and finish cooking until the center is creamy and fully cooked.
